test_case.test_name: Mapped BlueField InfiniBand solid-yellow Physical Up LED verification
test_case.purpose: Visually prove the exact BlueField InfiniBand physical connector displays the hardware-defined solid-yellow indication while that mapped IB port is in the approved Physical LinkUp state.
required_package: BlueField IB device/GUID/port/BDF and physical connector/link-partner map
Hardware-revision LED legend explicitly defining solid yellow as InfiniBand Physical Up
Approved IB cable/switch/loopback fixture and stable link-up configuration
Qualified operator/witness and timestamped color-faithful photo/video method
Optional synchronized ibstat/per-port corroboration and protected evidence storage
test_case.test_command: With the exact IB connector and hardware legend approved, establish the mapped InfiniBand link through the declared partner/fixture; a qualified operator records timestamped, color-faithful visual evidence that the correct physical LED is solid yellow while complete target-bound ibstat/port state corroborates Physical LinkUp; preserve logs and restore/retain the approved original fixture state.
test_case.expected_result: The exact mapped InfiniBand connector is physically linked, its declared indicator is visibly solid yellow under the hardware legend, synchronized IB state reports the approved Physical LinkUp condition, no Ethernet port/result is substituted and the final link/fixture remains healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct human visual proof of solid-yellow color on the mapped IB connector plus fixture and timestamp provenance. ibstat, counters, Ethernet LEDs or generic link state alone cannot establish the physical color criterion.
safety_gate: Verify IB device/port/GUID/physical connector and partner before touching any cable
Qualified operator performs observation/fixture work; do not disturb production, unmapped or Ethernet links
Use only the approved IB fixture and preserve network/platform logs
Stop on wrong connector, link loss, ambiguous color/legend or unexpected fabric effect; restore the original state and never retry automatically
expected_evidence: IB device/GUID/port/BDF/physical/partner map and hardware LED legend
Approved link fixture and stable Physical LinkUp record
Timestamped color-faithful photo/video showing solid yellow on the exact connector
Preserved logs and final link/fixture state
test_case.recovery: On wrong-port action or link loss, stop physical work, restore the documented original IB cable/switch/loopback state, verify Physical LinkUp and fabric health, preserve evidence and escalate. Do not use an Ethernet link or automatic retry as recovery proof.

source_conflict.reason: Master, DeepSeek and GPT agree on a manual physical IB LED test; the Review layer adds attributable mapping and evidence without altering solid-yellow semantics.

blocked.reason: Purpose, visual oracle, evidence and recovery are complete; exact IB map/fixture/operator are execution prerequisites.
